ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a cube; the front face, top face, and right face are all pasted with patterns made from identical square stickers; in the center of the front face, a diamond-shaped square sticker can be seen, and there are also stickers crossing the edges on the sides, which meet at corner points. Then reason: Let the diagonal length of each square sticker be d. Looking along the front face from the midpoint of the top edge to the midpoint of the bottom edge, the top edge-crossing sticker contributes d/2, the central sticker contributes d by crossing the middle, and the bottom edge-crossing sticker contributes another d/2. This whole length is exactly the cube edge length 10, so d/2 + d + d/2 = 10, giving d = 5. The area of a square equals half the square of its diagonal, so the area of each sticker is 5^2/2 = 25/2 cm^2. There are 6 face stickers and 12 edge stickers, 18 in total, so the total area is 18 × 25/2 = 225 cm^2.

method.method_draft: Use the visible front face as a 2D square face of side 10 cm. From the image, the face-centre sticker appears as a diamond-shaped square with a vertical/horizontal diagonal on the face, and each edge sticker is folded over an edge so that on this face it appears as a triangular half of the same square. Let d be the diagonal of one square sticker. A folded edge sticker contributes an inward triangular height d/2 from the edge, while the centre sticker spans distance d between its opposite corners. Because the diagram/text says the stickers meet at their corners, along a line from the midpoint of the top edge to the midpoint of the bottom edge the pieces exactly fill d/2 + d + d/2 = 10, so d = 5. The sticker area is d^2/2 = 25/2. From the text there is one sticker on each of 6 faces and one on each of 12 edges, so 18 stickers total. Multiply 18 · 25/2 = 225.

method.method_draft: Work by total covered area on the cube surface rather than by counting whole stickers first. On any one face, the image shows one full centre diamond plus four congruent triangular half-stickers centered on the four edges. Let h be the inward height of one triangular half-sticker; for a square sticker folded across an edge, h is half the sticker diagonal. The centre sticker has the same diagonal, so from the face centre to an edge the touching pieces occupy h from the edge-sticker triangle plus h from half of the centre diamond. Since half the cube face width is 5 cm, 2h = 5, so h = 2.5 and the sticker diagonal is 5. Thus the centre sticker area on one face is 5^2/2 = 12.5, and each triangular half-sticker area is half of that, 6.25. One face therefore has covered area 12.5 + 4(6.25) = 37.5. There are 6 faces, so total sticker area over the cube surface is 6 · 37.5 = 225.

图像描述：图中是一个立方体，能看到每个可见面上有一个位于面中心的菱形贴纸形状；沿着每条棱也有贴纸跨过棱放置，所以在单个面上，棱上的贴纸只露出一个三角形部分。图中这些中心菱形和边缘三角形的角彼此相接，形成连续的图案。

推理：按每个面的覆盖面积计算。立方体边长为 10 cm，所以从一个面的中心到任一条边的距离是 5 cm。设每个棱上三角形贴纸部分向面内伸入的高度为 h。跨棱的方形贴纸在一个面上形成半张贴纸，其高度 h 等于该方形贴纸对角线的一半；中心贴纸是同样大小的正方形，画成菱形，因此从面中心到它的一个顶点也是 h。图中中心贴纸和边缘三角形正好在角处相接，所以从面中心到边的 5 cm 被分成 h+h，即 2h=5。因此 h=2.5 cm，贴纸的对角线为 5 cm。一个正方形贴纸的面积为 d^2/2=5^2/2=12.5 cm²。每个面有一个完整中心贴纸，面积 12.5 cm²；还有四个棱上的半贴纸三角形，每个面积为 12.5/2=6.25 cm²。于是每个面的覆盖面积为 12.5+4×6.25=37.5 cm²。立方体有 6 个面，所以总贴纸面积为 6×37.5=225 cm²。
